beats.title: Rai and the Jade Fragment
beats.boundaryReason: Opening recap and camp conversation culminate in Kenzo explaining his visions and the connection to the Order of the Awakened Soul. The next beat turns to the expedition plan.
dateEvidence: Session YAML anchors May 11; u0025, u0030, and u0045 explicitly place the present camp at midday. Earlier events in the opening recap and Kenzo’s recollections do not advance the session date.

beats.title: Planning the Monastery Expedition
beats.boundaryReason: The party debates the monastery’s mysteries and chooses its route, leaving Baxter in charge of the mounts before setting off.
dateEvidence: Continues the midday camp; u0630-u0634 favor moving during the heat, and u0692-u0700 finalize departure.

beats.title: Approaching the Manticore Lair
beats.boundaryReason: Travel along the dry river gives way to scouting the monastery’s ruined dining hall and discovering the manticores; the party regroups afterward.
dateEvidence: u0704 specifies arrival after about ninety minutes at roughly two o’clock; u0762 advances to about 2:30 p.m. on the same day.

beats.title: Preparing the Manticore Ambush
beats.boundaryReason: The regrouped party debates bypassing the manticores, decides to protect its mounts by attacking, and settles on the driftglobe diversion.
dateEvidence: Continuous action after the 2:30 p.m. approach at u0762; invisibility’s limited duration shapes the planning. No rest or day transition occurs.

beats.title: The Manticore Fight
beats.boundaryReason: The driftglobe lures the young away; the adult ambush, pursuit, dispatch of the young, and search of the nest form a complete encounter before orcs arrive.
dateEvidence: Immediate continuation of the same afternoon; u1695-u1698 describe the fight as relatively quick but loud.

beats.title: Ambushing Grash’s Watchers
beats.boundaryReason: Six orcs investigate the noise, triggering a new fight that ends with their captain surrendering under Seeker’s Suggestion.
dateEvidence: u1736-u1745 place the approaching orcs within a minute of the previous fight; no intervening rest.

beats.title: Questioning the Orc Captain
beats.boundaryReason: The party interrogates the captive, debates his fate, and confines him in the bathhouse before choosing to explore the sacred doors.
dateEvidence: Directly follows the orc battle. The relief due tomorrow afternoon at u2178 is future information, not a time jump.

beats.title: Behind Bhishma’s Sacred Doors
beats.boundaryReason: Prayer opens the doors; the party collects holy water and encounters Bhishma’s immersive story. This beat ends just before Wellby and Delwath turn back.
dateEvidence: Continuous afternoon exploration after the interrogation. The reference to midnight at u2543 is a real-world stopping time, not an in-world transition.

beats.title: Following Bhishma into Death
beats.boundaryReason: Wellby and Delwath turn back while Kenzo and Seeker continue through Bhishma’s story and confront its demand for sacrifice; Kenzo dies while Seeker opens his eyes and unsuccessfully tries to heal him.
dateEvidence: u2555-u2563 divide the party at the corridor threshold; u2625-u2627 resume that same walk after real-world scheduling. Historical months, days, and events in u2629-u2704 belong to Bhishma’s vision, not elapsed time in the present.

beats.title: Kenzo’s New Sight
beats.boundaryReason: Kenzo revives and discovers a transformed view of the inner sanctuary, describing its paintings, fountain, and remembered flowers to Seeker.
dateEvidence: u2801 immediately follows Seeker’s attempt to understand Kenzo’s apparent death; the pair explore without a rest or other time jump.

beats.title: A Message about Shakun
beats.boundaryReason: Kenzo prays about Shakun and receives a message and the image of a stone heart; the session closes with discussion of his initiation and possible future character developments.
dateEvidence: u3012 says the prayer’s manifestation continues for five or ten minutes. Remaining talk is reflection and metagame discussion; no overnight passage occurs.
